verdict.rationale: Runpod documents creating GPU Pods from the console, CLI, REST API and GraphQL API, and its getting-started guide promises running code on a remote GPU in minutes. Templates make environments ready instantly, and SSH, JupyterLab and VS Code provide access. A runtime probe confirms the Pod REST API is live and key-gated, and community users describe deploying templates in a few clicks and getting H100s easily. One user reports 4090 'low availability' messages and occasional failed boots, which weakens the 'within minutes' promise for some GPU types. Missing for 10: independent timing evidence of the provision-to-running-code interval, and assurance of reliable GPU availability and boot success.
